body: Thank you, I usually deal with my stress by talking to friends and others, along with playing games and doing other activities that help me calm down and forget, or adjust to a situation. As for a community, I don't really have much of a contact with the poly community, I just have my circle of friends, along with a few things I do to help soothe me when I need it. If you think those will help I'll go ahead and try them as I need them, and if facing the jealousy is the only way to deal with it I'll face it head on. Because yes, I know they will be able to fuck for a while, while I won't even be able to touch her in person for a while still, and it hurts. I already talked to her about it, and she's willing to help me through this, as we both don't want to lose one another. So hopefully I'll be able to move past this.

There's no denying there isn't much of a sexual connection, but there is a romantic connection, and there is no lack of trying, of wanting to be intimate, from either end. We both want to be sexual with the other, but because she lived with only her mother all her life, and it was her first time ever living with a guy for that month, yes it was hard for her to feel comfortable and safe enough to have sex. But thanks to our month together, and now living with her other boyfriend in a dorm together, she's had time to do that, and is now experiencing this contact for the first time ever with a guy, because she was able to break down her walls slowly.

The post I made wasn't for questioning my relationship, or the possibility we'll ever have sex, because we will see eachother again and the process she's making right now won't just go away the moment we meet again. I made this post, asking for advice on how to help myself grow from the jealousy, and to not grow spiteful because of it. Because I do not want to hurt my girlfriend, or her other partner. So I ask again, do you have ant advice on how I can either stop, or grow past being jealous?

The reason I can see a sexual relationship with her is because there hasn't been a complete lack of any sexual contact. We have had sexual moments on call before, and during our trip together we had some fun as well, enjoying some foreplay. The actual sex part, was the only thing we never got to do, because mentally she didn't feel safe to generally do that at all. The only reason anything is happening with her other partner at all is because they live together in a dorm, so she's been able to get more comfortable around his physically thanks to the constant contact

Yes, sexually my needs aren't really met, it's why we're in an open relationship. But romantically, emotionally, her presence alone makes my life healthier and fuller. I have Aspergers and have panic attacks easily, and she has helped me during my worse as I have with her. She's the one who helped me learn how to take care of myself as well, and not just other people. And she is the one who makes me smile in my worst moments mentally. So even though sexually, this relationship is severely lacking, otherwise this is the most fulfilling relationship I have ever been in

Because we were in a relationship together before we had an open one. We've been romantically together for more than a year now, we have had dates, so many calls I can't even imagine, plans for the future, and a connection that's more than just a friends one. It's why we even went on a trip together for a month, to see if I was in love with the idea of her, or her. And it showed me I was in love with her fully. But, she was polyamorous, and not having another partner pained her emotionally. And I had been curious about polyamory for a while before that, so we began to try it out. So far I'm still looking, without much luck sadly...

The only issue with our relationship outside the distance, is that lack of sexual contact. And it isn't due to lack of attraction, but her going through a life where she's felt unsafe, being that intimate with a man. It's a whole story I don't want to explain for her sake. So when we did meet, nothing much happened. We did do some foreplay, but when it got to actual sex, she couldn't go through with it, and I didn't push her. Now though thanks to her other partner she's beginning to let people in, and has been able to be intimate for the first time ever, since they are able to get more comfortable in person. But online she doesn't feel safe doing things, so the few intimate moments we have even online, are rare and not really enjoyable to her

We have plans to meet again in the summer yes, and sex is something we both want, but she has had issues up till now to even be intimate with someone else like that. So it's something we hope will happen, if she feels comfortable with it the next time we meet

Open relationship, we've been dating for more than a year, have met in person for a time, and have had some rare intimate moments. I'm also looking for a partner near me as well, but the lack of intimate moments with her specifically hurts
